Name: PLAYAREA_GIANT_ASSET_CTRL_PARAM_ST
Description: Giant field assets driven by the in-game clock: one group moves across the map over time, and both groups get a material value that changes between two times of day. Only row 0 is used.

Fields.Name: Moving Assets: Asset ID
Fields.Description: Model number of the assets that move with the clock (AEG594_010 is 594010). Retail 594010.

Fields.Name: Moving Assets: Instance Number - Min
Fields.Description: Lowest instance number of the moving assets (Likely the number after the model in the placed asset's name). Retail 1000.

Fields.Name: Moving Assets: Instance Number - Max
Fields.Description: Highest instance number of the moving assets (inclusive). Retail 2000.

Fields.Name: Fixed Assets: Asset ID
Fields.Description: Model number of the assets that stay in place but share the visibility and material value (AEG594_011 is 594011). Retail 594011.

Fields.Name: Fixed Assets: Instance Number - Min
Fields.Description: Lowest instance number of the fixed assets. Retail 1000.

Fields.Name: Fixed Assets: Instance Number - Max
Fields.Description: Highest instance number of the fixed assets (inclusive). Retail 2000.

Fields.Name: Moving Assets: Speed
Fields.Description: How far the moving assets travel per in-game second, along a fixed horizontal direction taken from each asset's placement. Retail 0.1.

Fields.Name: Moving Assets: Active Range
Fields.Description: A moving asset farther than this from the reference point on the X or Z axis is turned off. Retail 99999 (never).

Fields.Name: Material Ex Param ID
Fields.Description: MaterialExParam row that the time-of-day value drives on both asset groups. No row: nothing is set up. Retail 4000.

Fields.Name: Material Value: Start Hour
Fields.Description: In-game hour at which the material value starts moving from its start value. Retail 10.

Fields.Name: Material Value: Start Minute
Fields.Description: Minutes added to the start hour. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Material Value: End Hour
Fields.Description: In-game hour at which the material value reaches its end value (0:00 counts as 24:00; a range past midnight wraps). Retail 19.

Fields.Name: Material Value: End Minute
Fields.Description: Minutes added to the end hour. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Material Value: Start
Fields.Description: Material value up to the start time; it changes linearly to the end value by the end time. If the end value is not greater, this value is used all day. Retail 0.25.

Fields.Name: Material Value: End
Fields.Description: Material value from the end time on. Retail 0.7.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: With Unknown 13-15, adds a second term to each asset's material value; there is none when this equals Unknown 13. Exact roles not established. Retail 0.3.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Paired with Unknown 12 (see there). Read as a decimal value. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: With Unknown 15, a second pair used for the extra material term; there is none when the two are equal. Exact roles not established. Retail 50000.
